conclusion: The native CPU control returns normally on port 3-3 and completes every wake sample. DMA, GPU and NPU completion timing is unmeasured (budgets 250, 1,000 and 1,000 us).
narrative: Conditions: CPU-L 1794 MHz at 1000 mV, CPU-B 2002 MHz at 1050 mV. The two largest overruns precede the top-point workload by 132 ms; the workload itself reaches 62.750 us masked and 73.417 us task-lock wait (core 6).
